accommodation_properties.name: Hotel Arcadia
accommodation_properties.description: Four-star hotel a ten-minute walk from the venue. Breakfast included, late check-out on request.

accommodation_properties.name: Pine Ridge Cabins
accommodation_properties.description: Timber cabins in the woods, twenty minutes out of town. Shuttle to the venue twice a day.

accommodation_properties.name: Summit Residences
accommodation_properties.description: Serviced apartments next to the conference centre. Kitchen, laundry and desk in every unit - built for long stays.

accommodation_properties.name: Riverside Glamping
accommodation_properties.description: Furnished tents and geodesic domes by the river. Open for the week of the summit only.

accommodation_properties.name: The Hive Hostel
accommodation_properties.description: Budget beds in the old town, five stops from the venue. Shared kitchen and a very loud coffee machine.

accommodations.name: Classic Single
accommodations.description: Compact room with a single bed, a desk and a street view.

accommodations.name: Classic Double
accommodations.description: Queen bed, sitting area and a full bathroom. The workhorse room of the hotel.

accommodations.name: Deluxe Twin
accommodations.description: Two single beds for colleagues travelling together. Corner rooms on the quiet side of the building.

accommodations.name: Arcadia Suite
accommodations.description: Top-floor suite with a private terrace, a separate living room and a soaking tub.

accommodations.name: Forest Cabin
accommodations.description: One-room timber cabin with a wood stove and a porch. No wifi, on purpose.

accommodations.name: Family Lodge
accommodations.description: Two-bedroom lodge sleeping five, with a kitchen and a lake view from the deck.

accommodations.name: Studio Apartment
accommodations.description: Open-plan studio with a kitchenette, a washer and a proper desk.

accommodations.name: Two-Bedroom Apartment
accommodations.description: Separate bedrooms, a full kitchen and a living room that fits a whiteboard.

accommodations.name: Penthouse Loft
accommodations.description: Double-height loft on the top floor, with a terrace over the tech park.

accommodations.name: Safari Tent
accommodations.description: Canvas tent on a wooden platform, a real bed, and a shared bathhouse fifty metres away.

accommodations.name: Stargazer Dome
accommodations.description: Geodesic dome with a transparent panel over the bed. Private shower, no phone signal.

accommodations.name: Shared Dorm Bed
accommodations.description: One bunk in a mixed eight-bed dorm. Locker, reading light and a power socket per bed.

accommodations.name: Private Twin
accommodations.description: Private room with two single beds and a shared bathroom down the hall.
